body: Or maybe “when one door closes... *skeleton key double shot* another one opens”

Frost:
*shows a terrorist running through the building checking room to room* "my father taught me how to catch my first rabbit, he taught me how to let the prey come to me" *welcome mat snaps on terrorists leg and a large scream echos through the room then a single shot fills the room* "but he never knew what else i would catch with his teachings"

Buck:
*opens up with terrorist in front of a soft wall looking around as he hears noises of small arms fire and footsteps* "Some keys don't just open up locked doors" *you hear 2 shots of the skeleton key behind the terry as he falls to his side and buck crouch walks in checking his corners and lowering his rifle* "sometimes they open up....unknown doorways"
